notes.title: Check out our free e-comic book!
notes.content:
Hey there ːsteamhappyː

Look what we made! https://stupidstupidgames.itch.io/ticket-to-darkness


[i]Ticket to Darkness is the first part of a stand-alone prequel e-comic for the PC-game Johnny Graves - The Unchosen One.

The story is set in 1889 Paris, where a young Agent of Heaven, Elise, is setting herself up to go on an undercover mission to Hell. We love you <3

notes.title: The Best 5 Bucks You’ve Ever Spent!

notes.title: Squashed a few bugs...
notes.content:
Hey players!

A patch just went live, addressing issues that have been brought to our attention since full launch.

- The checkpoint bug is fixed (as far as we can tell). Let us know if it persists. 
- Glitchy movement has been softened. If the problem continues, try turning on v-sync.
- The first couple of levels are now quicker to get through, allowing players get to the main action sooner. 
- Roof-jumping has been adjusted to be slightly less difficult.
- The first boss now has less health. 
- Johnny's walking pace is slightly faster.
- A few other small tweaks and fixes here and there.

The update should not affect existing saves or progress. However, if you're continuing the game from either one of the first two levels (Subway tunnels or Station) after this update and you [i] do [/i] encounter any gameplay issues, try the following: Main Menu -> Settings -> Reset saved data. This will reset your saved progress in the game. 

Thanks for all your feedback, and keep it coming! You're helping us be better devs.

Happy gaming ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hunting Down & Destroying Bugs
notes.content:
Hi guys! 

Just wanted to let everyone know, that we're aware of certain bugs in the game, and we're presently working on examining and fixing them. In the meantime, here are some solutions you can try: 

- If you're experiencing problems with your checkpoints, try restarting the game.
- If you're experiencing glitchy movement, we recommend turning on v-sync.

We massively appreciate you notifying us of the bugs, and thank you for your patience and understanding while fix them!

Happy gaming ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: FULL LAUNCH! Johnny finally goes to Hell... on a rampage, with a revolver.
notes.content:
Today is the day: Johnny Graves - The Unchosen One is now a full game. Every feature we planned, all of the story, every level and every achievement is there. It is done! 

We'll be supporting it and fixing any possible bugs, of course, and we might even do some additional polishing and tweaking. But our job is mostly done; it's your turn now!

[i]Plunge into the civil war of Hell. Take Johnny - the bastard son of the new Satan and imprisoner of the old - through the front lines of clashing troops, to the very heart of the battle between two evils. Stop Johnny's family from bringing the war over the mortal divide, straight into New York City. Save the world... for now.[/i]

We've updated all of the storytelling sequences and added a short introduction video - the story so many of you loved is even better now. We've added achievements, so you can show off your success. There are also pickup upgrades; those awesome gun magic skills don't come for free, you know. 

Lastly, if the game isn't hard enough for you, there will be a new game plus option available when you've played it through the first time.

Please let us know what you think! Johnny is our first game, and no matter how proud we are, we'd like to do better next time.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: ARCADE PLAY MADNESS MODE Until Full Launch!
notes.content:
We told you we wouldn't be updating Johnny anymore, before the full launch. But surprise - we did!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/b78d34ef886f4b21de3b83b0ebd457aa54a123e4.png[/img]

After fixing a very annoying bug - Johnny getting stuck on stuff - we decided to give you guys a bit more than just a bug fix. Starting today, Johnny is in Arcade Play Madness Mode until full launch - that is, from March 15th to April 6th 2017. This means you can use ALL the gun spells right from the start. After full launch, you'll have to earn most of them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/495b811c8dd96a468c17f6b20523c769ba4301d8.png[/img]

We've also added a bunch of new stuff:
-a tutorial 
-another Chinatown level
-a new, better model for Johnny
-all the gun spells
-2 new enemies

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/fd1c7d15b9da7d85e4328fcf3d792408979828d7.png[/img]

On top of this, you'll get a glimpse of the polishing we're doing. We've improved the combat feel, graphics quality and object fading, among other things. There's still a lot of polishing to be done, but the work has started.

Go try the Arcade Play Madness Mode - blast them, freeze them, destroy them! And after you're done, please come back and let us know how it was. Did you enjoy it? What was the best part? What sucks? Is Johnny hot, or do you like the cultists better? Anything helps!

Happy gaming!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/628b0bf79cc3d84bb3414f336e4355fa82039a35.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Johnny's Awakened in our January update!
notes.content:
Johnny is now Awakened and has more magic skills right from the start of the game. In the Subway tunnels, you can use blink, shoot several enemies with one ricochet shot, destroy a fast enemy with an arcane missile, or explode monsters with a ground shot. Later on, you'll unlock an endothermic shot - and there's more to come in the full launch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/f0756477fee59e3b1c06058f3a23cfc78296d43d.png[/img]

After finding his way out of the subway tunnels, on his way to St. Mary's cathedral, Johnny has to walk through Chinatown and fight the imps. Those little jerks throw bombs at him and keep blinking away from under his aim. And you thought you hated the spiders...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/cafdfdbdf0347f1de87f2f0764a005a2ad2a823e.png[/img]

We know, the game is hard. It's supposed to be. But sometimes it's been hard for the wrong reasons - some of you have experienced lagging, and sometimes trees or buildings prevented you from seeing Johnny. For this update, we've improved the performance, and added object fading technology to keep your line of sight clear.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/d6acf331fbfa13a5c71fee9fe102ea91fe3cd49d.png[/img]

On top of this, we've been improving the particle effects, rebalancing gameplay, and making new camera runs. Even though there are still levels and features to add, the polishing work has also begun.

Next big update will be full launch! If you haven't bought the game yet and would like to get it for the EA price, you'd better hurry.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/bb74994d4b6ffdd2a141c9e6f7219580e869569b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
It's 2017 and the full release is getting closer. We plan on doing at least one regular Early Access launch, probably after January, and then focus all our effort on the final version of the game. The update will include an upcoming level, as well as more Gun Spells to blast enemies with.

We’ve also been reworking the game’s narrative. We want to tell the story of Armageddon, the families of Hell and their impact on the world. With the early Johnny Graves story line it was hard to communicate all the things happening in the background. We like Johnny but he is only one part in a large, moving universe. We’ve refocused on what really matters in the story, and we believe the new approach will make the game come alive like never before.

The Necromancer ebook was also recently released, and we strongly recommend it! It serves as a standalone novel as well as sets the scene for the events of Johnny Graves – The Unchosen One. 

https://www.amazon.com/dp/B01N7K4P31

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/f8ddf4acb0806e93837040d4abaf88317ff8c813.jpg[/img]

Since the story overhaul will affect the whole game from start to finish, it won’t be included in the regular Early Access update. It simply wouldn’t make sense to update parts of the dialogue into the existing one as they are being made. However, as a teaser to the new Johnny, you’ll have access to multiple Gun Spells right from the beginning. For those that haven’t defeated the bosses yet, there’ll be some more firepower to even the playing field!

notes.title: Update from Game Lead
notes.content:
Johnny has been in early access for about six months now. During this time we've received some great feedback from you guys. We've reworked, tweaked and altered many things based on the things we've heard the Early Access players comment. This has helped us take some large steps forward, and closer to the final, finished version of the game.

Thanks to the Early Access model, we've been able to identify and fix many potential problems early on, as well as discover what players have particularly enjoyed in Johnny, so we can emphasize those elements in the future. The community feedback also makes it very clear which bugs are the highest priority to you, so we know to tackle those first (*cough* shooting at trees *cough*).

One of the first recurring comments during the first Early Access level was the brief length of the game relative to the price tag. Many felt that it should be longer for what we were asking, and we agreed. We've since lowered the price and focused on releasing more playable content, putting a priority on level development over gameplay development and most other things. Now that the fourth level, the Station, is out, we are content with the amount of time you can expect from Johnny at this stage of development. This means we can focus more of our efforts into improving the gameplay again - new spells coming soon!

We do want to keep our players happy, so we've been aiming to release an update every month or two. So far we've been able to stick to our schedules, even though something unexpected seems to be lurking around every time a release is getting closer. But we've learned we should rather cut some features from the release and postpone them to the polishing stage of development, than keep delaying the new content for players. 

While having a tight update schedule definitely adds more pressure to the development team, and we can't always give all the levels the love we want to before release, it has allowed us to iterate things like the core combat mechanics over and over, slowly creating the gameplay experience we want it to be. That experience should be a real challenge, a learning curve that keeps you on the edge of your seat until you beat that one boss, and a rewarding feel of success when you do. We want you to finish the game, but we want you to work for it. How do you think we've succeeded so far?

-Eelis Aaltonen, Game Lead

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/2e14d8e095629644cc50177c2912cc406ac620b6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Golem
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/08dbacea0e4fed7c677a53be205030c8f4fbf2c4.jpg[/img]

The Golem was a monster we wanted to create as the main working horse of the Crimsons, who are the current lords of Hell. The idea was that it was constructed from flesh and magic around a steel-expanded skeleton and packed an immense punch, capable of stopping trains. It's power is put to use in a multitude of ways in Hell, but they're mostly used for heavy lifting.

After the initial concepts I moved the production to 3D-Coat and started sculpting. Lots of the creative work ended up being done in the sculpting phase and that took around a week. Next I got into retopology and dropped the vertex count of the model from around 16 million to 15 thousand. I started with using the automatic retopology tools in 3D-Coat and swapped over to the manual tools for a few days. I triangulated the model in Blender and made sure the silhouette was solid from all angles.

The texturing was mostly done in Substance Painter. This included a lot of creative work and evaluation about how we could make it read well in the environments we'd put it in. This stage took about a couple of days.

The last phase for me was rigging and skinning, and I used Blender's Rigify tools to give me a base skeleton, to which I added some extra bones, and let it generate a rig for me. I love how quick Rigify makes rigging, it really saves an immense amount of time and the rigs it generates are great for our purposes. Generating the rig took about an hour, and fixing the automatic vertex weights took the rest of the day.

Next we handed off the model to our animator and after he was finished, we set it up in Unity to replace our "Box Golem", which was literally made out of three boxes for prototyping purposes. It's great to see the team effort turn into a finished monster in the game! ːsteamhappyː

The picture was rendered in Blender using Cycles. Feel free to use it as a wallpaper and thanks for reading!

-Jaakko Jaakkola, 3D artist

notes.title: Johnny's Surprise Family Reunion In Our November Update!
notes.content:
Johnny made it through the maze of subway tunnels to an emergency exit leading up to the subway station. This is where our new level (out on Nov 30th) takes place: beginning in the winding corridors and deserted platforms of the station, and ending with a boss fight on the rooftops of New York. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/f6f53efccb9bacb00bfdca4a1b2e6a212114810b.png[/img]

To Johnny's inconvenience, the new boss can control animals, including Hellhounds. He also happens to be the half-brother that Johnny didn't know he had. Perhaps, in different circumstances, the news would have been welcome.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/96f422745e09d2cdf1296ff57a4944e3239a69d3.png[/img]

This update concludes the Subway level - marking our progress at 50% complete - and one more level will be added between this one and the cemetery. As well as adding a new level and a new boss, we've improved our UI and level lighting.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/04bce5d3b6451f73d897e41d9c48d58a2f6a3d22.png[/img]

We're incredibly excited to share this level with you! Please let us know what you think, your feedback and support mean the world to us.

Happy gaming :)

notes.title: Subway lighting bug defeated & other little improvements!
notes.content:
We've finally conquered that pesky bug with our latest patch, added today (Oct 21st)! More details:

- Subway level lighting has been reworked and will no longer malfunction where it previously did
- Subway level lighting is more optimized and should function more efficiently on less powerful devices
- A solution to reduce level load times has been added
- Occasional "blocky" appearance of certain particles has been fixed
- Navigation AI of Golem has been improved
- A level load screen after Subway level intro has been added

We humbly apologize to anyone who's gaming experience was affected by the Subway lighting bug! Try it again now - it's much more fun when you can see, we promise ːsteamhappyː. 

As always, thank you for all your precious feedback and support, and keep it coming!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: The bugfixing continues...
notes.content:
Just to get you guys up to speed: the potentially game-breaking problem we're having is with the lighting (or lack thereof) in the subway tunnels. It only appears to occur on some computers, mainly laptops. So if you're playing the subway level and the tunnels are completely dark, you've fallen victim to this stubborn glitch. But have no fear! We're working like house elves to put it right. ːsteamhappyː

Also, if you've played Johnny Graves before, you'll have to get to the level via Level Select, which you'll find in the menu. 

We'll let you know when we've conquered the bug!

notes.title: Go Back In Time With Johnny In Our October Update!
notes.content:
If you've ever played our game and wondered how exactly Johnny wound up in a zombie-infested cemetery, you'll be pleased to know that our latest update, out on Oct 13th, will help clear that up for you. Remember how things ended after the boss battle with Padre? Well, we're not going into the catacombs just yet - we're going back in time, to the very first level. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/b0934c1c6dd4b64ff37d6addf3238497ad314cc0.png[/img]

This update will take you to the beginning of that fateful night... back to when Johnny was just an ordinary guy in New York, riding the subway one evening to meet a friend. That's when all Hell broke loose, quite literally. After a mysterious subway train accident, Johnny finds himself wandering the ominous underground tunnels alone, trusty revolver in hand. Only, he's not alone. Something caused those trains to crash, and that something was a new monster of ours... a Golem.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/382b718c6cb9ea4d6e0b26cc6edc597c7b265f4a.png[/img]

There is a gap between this level and the next, which is to be filled with a couple of upcoming patches. Because we've gone back in time, Johnny hasn't discovered any of his special abilities yet. Therefore blink and magic shot are disabled, but don't panic! It's just for this one level. However, Johnny can now walk while shooting, which is a permanent adjustment, and objects in the foreground will no longer interfere with aiming and shooting.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/db7b3ba9f543b044767e761ca52647c1414b9a5d.png[/img]

We sincerely hope you enjoy this update! If you have any comments, questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to get in touch with us. We love hearing from you! Happy gaming, dear friends.

notes.title: We've lowered our price!
notes.content:
Dear friends and followers,

After receiving a ton of feedback about the price of Johnny Graves - The Unchosen One being a little too far on the steep side, we've decided to lower it from 14,99e to a more gentle sum: 6,99e. Once again, thank you all for pointing us in the right direction with your feedback! As first-time game developers, we need all the help and encouragement we can get. 

Happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: First major update will be published late summer 2016
notes.content:
The first major update for Johnny Graves—The Unchosen One will be published late summer 2016. It will include one more level, two new monsters, one bossfight, and one magic ability. We'll also add the most requested gameplay feature: checkpoints.

We've received lots of feedback about not having checkpoints in the game. Johnny Graves was always supposed to be quite a hard game, and it's clear we've succeeded at that (unless you've found one of the ways to break the game - we're not telling you). However, it is frustrating to start again from the beginning every time you die. After the first update, you won't have to.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/96e92dd5357e9b32e01f70a1229d471dce5665ef.jpg[/img]

After surviving the graveyard, Johnny enters St. Mary's Cathedral. Even though it's a spacious cathedral, he won't have too much leeway; the monsters don't have much respect for personal space. Expect for an intense fight.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/f910a3cc5dd9f5009c52d25a7932f730f207446e.jpg[/img]

Johnny will also encounter one of our favourite monsters: the Puppet Master. This slender giant has been manufactured in the monster factories of Hell. He's not a fighter himself, but has a very useful ability: necromantia. Might explain the zombie horde Johnny encountered at the graveyard.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/97f1a6c2848d56f3cef2ad8493e5a30c918f4022.png[/img]

Luckily, one of Johnny's old magic skills comes back to him when he's starting to remember his past lives better. In Cathedral, you'll be able to use Blink, short range teleport ability. It's the perfect backstabber's ability - bet Johnny used it a lot when he still was an agent of Hell.

We hope and believe you'll enjoy the updates! If you've got any questions or comments on them or anything else related to Johnny, please let us know! The discussion board is at your service.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25242796/4530e7f8e0bd65018e8d2731ff7e47380317ad79.png[/img]
